purpose: Evidence supporting corrected model choices and limits on what the sources establish

entries.scope: The national maximum IT-load figure includes CFA2's 200 MW. The separate 700 MW Jurong Island park figure is total electricity demand and overlaps with CFA2.

entries.value: Liquid cooling is shared by the compared configurations
entries.source: EDB and IMDA fact sheet, 21 August 2026
entries.scope: Confirms four allocations of 50 MW, liquid-cooling adoption and Jurong Island location; does not establish heat-rejection equipment costs or an incremental dry-cooling PUE.

entries.locator: Annex B, NEWater, From 1 April 2025 column
entries.scope: Operator bill components; not a marginal resource-cost estimate. The live official page was checked; downloaded snapshots were not rewritten.

entries.locator: Annex A, Non-Domestic Potable Water Prices, From 1 April 2025 column
entries.scope: Operator tariff; does not prove desalination's marginal resource cost.

entries.locator: Printed pages 4 and 7, additional near-term capacity; page 16, water efficiency
entries.scope: The roadmap does not establish an additional 300 MW tranche beyond CFA2. S2 and S3 are team-defined nonoverlapping growth scenarios, not published allocations.

entries.source: PUB sectoral water efficiency benchmark, December 2025
entries.locator: Sectoral Water Efficiency Benchmarks table, Data Centres row; WUE denominator defined in IMDA roadmap page 16 footnote 9
entries.scope: Existing-fleet benchmark, transferred to new wet-rejection sites as a proxy. It is not a measured CFA2 design performance.

entries.locator: Tabular Data workbook, T2.3!U6 (2024), T2.3!V6 (2025), note in row 12
entries.scope: Generation-weighted operational CO2 factor, not a complete lifecycle electricity factor. Future grid paths are team scenarios.

Lists domestic photovoltaics and fuels including biomethane, ammonia and hydrogen. No zero-emission factor follows from the policy share. Tested intensities are illustrative; the primary result uses full grid intensity.

entries.locator: Reduce subsection, paragraph on scaling and validating desalination technologies
entries.scope: The lower value was a technology target, not evidence that all plants achieved it. No claim is made that 3.5 is a measured 2026 Jurong Island plant value.

entries.source: Shehabi et al., 2024 US Data Center Energy Usage Report
entries.scope: Range refers to reported airside-economizer and adiabatic systems with air-cooled chillers; system details are uncertain. It does not validate tropical liquid/dry-rejection WUE. Retained register entry is contextual only.

entries.locator: Hourly variables and weather-model selection documentation; local file time and temperature_2m columns
entries.scope: Exact temperature exceedance is recomputed from retained hourly records. Original request does not pin a model; do not call this an ERA5-only record. Threshold and heat share are engineering assumptions. No independent station comparison or future climate adjustment was performed.

entries.locator: Key Updates to Singapore's Carbon Tax from 2024
entries.scope: 65 is a midpoint assumption, not an announced fixed rate. Valuation sensitivities are separate from resource cost and do not represent incremental tax bills.

entries.locator: Rows identified by model_keys; structural_sensitivity.csv and cooling_thresholds.csv
entries.scope: These inputs lack site-specific calibration or complete source support. Zero discharge treatment cost means omitted from the primary accounting, not free treatment. Cost years are not harmonised to verified 2026 procurement quotes. Sensitivity ranges do not constitute validation.

entries.source: PUB BESIN-UEN consortium press release, 18 September 2014
entries.locator: PDF page 1, third paragraph: first-year price and 25-year supply period
entries.scope: Historical first-year concession price, not a 2026 marginal cost. The model contextual plot retains an approximate 0.30 reference; resource costs are calculated separately.

entries.source: Team model choices; proposal horizon; historical concession context
entries.scope: Retail tariffs do not establish a DC electricity contract; a concession term does not measure asset life. Calendar bounds are study choices. The latent-heat value is a calibration-check assumption without a retained specific table reference. Numeric values are unchanged; they are not classified as verified observations.

entries.source: Sustainability Impact Metrics eco-cost workbook; team valuation scenario
entries.locator: Retained workbook sheet 'ecocosts emissions 2025', row 139, Carbon dioxide, columns I and K
entries.scope: The adopted central factor matches the retained workbook CO2 entry. Its use for this assessment is a valuation scenario, not measured environmental damage. Sensitivity bounds and currency conversion are assumptions. The factor is excluded from primary resource cost and AHP; it affects separately labelled eco-cost valuation outputs.
